title: Legacy template used where a Settings Catalog equivalent exists

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile uses', 'profiles use')} a legacy template with a Settings Catalog equivalent

messages.businessImpact: Legacy templates receive no new settings and are gradually being retired, so the estate is being configured through a route that will eventually stop being maintained.
remediation: Recreate each profile in the Settings Catalog, verify on a pilot group, then retire the template.
Do this one profile at a time; both applying at once is a conflict.
